verdict.rationale: v0 documents a public API (v0.app/docs/api/platform) offering programmatic access to chat, project management, code generation and deployment features, backed by an official SDK (v0-sdk on GitHub) demonstrating real usage like v0.chats.create and streaming responses. This gives AI-native users a documented, callable API and SDK to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/rate limits and broader community validation beyond the vendor docs and SDK repo.
